items.title: A coordination framework for formal proof development with Kiro
items.summary: MAESTRO is a prover harness in Kiro CLI that gives large language models a coordination framework for exploring, decomposing, and making structured progress on difficult proofs. It solves more hard theorems than Codex and Claude Code, including all six 2026 IMO problems in 1 hour 46 minutes.
items.creator: Haoyu Li
